source_document.reuse_terms: Not stated as a copyright notice on the EOC itself. Definitions reference 'Current Dental Terminology© ("CDT") number assigned to a Single Procedure by the American Dental Association'. Trademarks used in text: 'Delta Dental PPOTM' / 'Delta Dental PPOSM' and 'Delta Dental Premier®'. HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices states 'This notice is effective on and after January 1, 2017.' Document is publicly posted by a state university HR office.
access_limits: WebFetch's answering model refused one request to reproduce all of Attachment B verbatim (fair-use refusal); worked around with item-by-item short-quote prompts.

Page attribution inside Attachment B varied by +/-1 between fetch passes for Limitations items 4 (fluoride: reported p.2 and p.3) and 24 (crowns: reported p.4 and p.5); the Continuation of Benefits paragraph in the main document was reported on p.3 and p.4. Pages below are the majority/most-consistent reading and are marked needs_review where passes disagreed. Verify each quote on its page at seeding.

No 2025 or 2026 Evidence of Coverage or MSU-specific rate sheet was found: the HRM dental page (last modified 2026-05-04T13:59:37-05:00 per page metadata) still links this 2024-03 EOC and a 2021 Benefit Highlights sheet; WebSearch for 2025/2026 MSU Delta Dental rates returned nothing MSU-specific.
